20	- **Document types:** `blogFrontPage` (title, intro, blocks) and `blogPost` (summary, coverImage, publishedDate, blocks) in Pages; `heroBlock`, `richTextBlock`, `imageBlock`, `quoteBlock`, `callToActionBlock` in Blocks; `blockSettings` (anchor, spacing) in Compositions, composed onto every block.
21	- **Data types:** Block Grid (all 5 blocks) and Block Spacing dropdown, both in `/Custom` (not `/Custom/<editor>`).

There are 5 adapters in `Views/Partials/blockgrid/Components/`, 5 ViewComponents with views in `Views/Shared/Components/<Name>/Default.cshtml`, and plain models in `Models/Blocks/`. Grid CSS and rich-text typography were added to `Umbraco.Bench.Frontend/src/site.css` and built.
24	- **Look:** a clean Tailwind layout with a white header, slate background and rounded dark CTA/hero panels. The front page renders the intro text, a CTA, then the hero, and only then a "Latest posts" grid of two cards (image, date, title, summary). Posts show the date, title and summary, then a cover image directly followed by a second hero image, then the text, a captioned image, a quote and a CTA.
